positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
• Developing web applications to provide an engaging learning environment for middle school students. 
• Using Google App scripts to sort data from a project results form to generate personal feedback letters.

positions.title: University Fundraiser

projects.title: Distributed Key-Value Store - C
projects.description: Created a distributed Key-Value store running across multiple server nodes. Implemented the Two-Phase Commit Protocol to enforce consistency across all distributed transactions

projects.title: Projective Set - AngularJS
projects.description:
• Created a simple implementation of the game Projective Set
• Used the AngularJS framework by Google to elegantly display the cards in the game
• Developed a simple representation of cards that allowed set detection to be trivial (xor==0)
• Generalized the code to be functional for any size of dots with automatic resizing cards
• Implemented a method to show the user a set if they get stuck
